blocks.title: About us
blocks.body:
Test Doctor / clinic is a doctor / clinic in Rewari since 2015. We offer consultation, follow-up visits, basic tests & reports, injections & dressing. We give every customer our full time and tell the price before we start.

Listens before prescribing, Explains in simple words, Appointment on WhatsApp — that is how we work. How it goes: Book or walk in → Bring your reports → Consultation → Follow-up. Message us on WhatsApp and we reply quickly — for Rewari and nearby.

items.a: Walk-ins are seen during clinic hours; an appointment on WhatsApp saves waiting.
Old reports, prescriptions and the medicines you are taking; for children, the vaccination card.
See the timings on this page, or message us to check before you come.

items.q: Does the doctor see children and the elderly?
items.a: Message us the patient's age and problem; we will tell you whether to come here or see a specialist.

items.q: Can I consult on phone or video?
items.a: For follow-ups and reports, ask on WhatsApp; a first visit is usually better in person.

items.q: Are tests done at the clinic?
items.a: Basic checks are done here; for other tests we guide you to a lab and read the reports.
Cash and UPI at the clinic; ask us the consultation fee on WhatsApp.
